title: GL Journal / Posting
description: The individual debit-and-credit entry that actually moves a dollar amount from one account to another when an RO closes, a part sells, or a deal funds.
x-sap-analogue: BKPF/BSEG (accounting document header and line items)
x-api-note: Fortellis documents multiple GL posting/interface APIs by name (Journal Entry, Post to GL) at the catalogue level, but full request/response field schemas for a generic journal entry object were not found in the accessible material.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

reference_number_source_document_link.description: Ties the journal line back to the originating RO, deal, or parts invoice — your audit trail

account_number_debit_credit_line.description: The GL account number being debited or credited on this line

debit_credit_amount.description: The dollar amount posted on this line, and whether it's a debit or a credit

posting_date_accounting_period.description: The date/period the entry posts to, which drives which month's financials it affects

department_code_cost_centre_tag.description: The department tag carried onto the journal line so departmental P&Ls roll up correctly

auto_generated_source_flag_ro_close_deal.description: Tags whether this journal line was auto-created by closing an RO, finalizing a deal, or a parts sale, versus a manual entry
auto_generated_source_flag_ro_close_deal.x-cdk-field-name: Auto-generated source flag (RO close / deal finalize / parts sale)
